title: exists nonempty support open piece model
statement:
theorem exists_nonempty_support_open_piece_model
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace T]
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) Ab.{u + 1}) (padicAlgClRingObj T ℓ))
    (S : Scheme.Stratification T)
    (hS : ∀ a : Fin S.n,
      ∃ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields ℓ (PadicAlgCl ℓ))
        (M_E : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (S.domain a)) Ab.{u + 1})
          ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (S.immersion a)).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E))),
        IsLocallyFinitelyPresented
          ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (S.immersion a)).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E)) M_E ∧
        Nonempty ((Mod.extendScalars ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (S.immersion a)).map
          (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl T ℓ E))).obj M_E ≅
            (((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (S.immersion a)).mapMod
              (padicAlgClRingObj T ℓ)).obj M)))
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (i : Y ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i] [Nonempty Y]
    :
    ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (j : U ⟶ Y), IsOpenImmersion j ∧ Nonempty U ∧
      ∃ (EU : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields ℓ (PadicAlgCl ℓ))
        (PU : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1})
          (padicSubfieldRingObj U ℓ EU)),
        IsConstructibleModuleObject (padicSubfieldRingObj U ℓ EU) PU ∧
        Nonempty ((Mod.extendScalars (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl U ℓ EU)).obj PU ≅
          (CondensedRing.upperStar (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) (j ≫ i)).obj M). This is the exact Lean statement, with the definitions cited in stmt_deps.

source.place: support induction; stratum restriction and strict closed complement

proof.text: Pull the stratification back to Y. Its union of stratum interiors is dense. Pick a point in this union and let U be the interior of its stratum; the range of U -> T lies in the original stratum. This uses the proved source lemma dense_iUnion_interior_stratum, not irreducible-component induction.

Normalize the supplied raw stratum model by extending along condensedPullbackHom. Extension along this ring isomorphism preserves local finite presentation; the coefficient square and extendScalarsComp identify its scalar extension with normalized pullback of M.
Transport the normalized finite model through the stratum immersion to U, then use the trivial stratification to obtain constructibility.
